title: Raw-workflow sync refuses whenever any generated workflow is dirty, even with no template changed
description: scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs:130-148 refuses ('orchestrate.py rebuilds ALL templates') on ANY uncommitted file under comfy_workflows/ outside raw/, BEFORE it knows what changed (line 150). orchestrate.py only runs when a changed raw is a _template (line ~245, if (anyTemplate)), so a plain raw edit is blocked by a peer's unrelated staged runtime file. Hit twice in a row on MPI-936 (2026-10-08, both sessions converted + validated by hand). Fix: compute the changed set first; refuse on dirty generated files only when a changed raw is a template (or --all), and otherwise only when the converted file's OWN output path is dirty. Fabio approved as its own card 2026-10-08.
